name: Global Index Medicus
operator: WHO Global Library Group / BIREME PAHO WHO
geographic_scope: Five WHO Regional Indexes Medici: AIM IMEMR IMSEAR LILACS WPRIM
notes: Live GIM portal displays five regional sources; aggregated discovery is not journal endorsement.

name: African Index Medicus
geographic_scope: African health research and Africa-related articles
notes: Current AIM site and selection description verified; item-level index membership requires journal record.

name: Index Medicus for Eastern Mediterranean Region
operator: WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean
geographic_scope: WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region; policy page lists 23 areas
notes: WHO selection criteria say English abstracts expected; some important Arabic-only research may remain absent.

name: Index Medicus for South-East Asia Region
operator: WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia
notes: GIM explicitly displays IMSEAR; independent interface and current selection criteria still to verify.

name: Western Pacific Region Index Medicus
operator: WHO Regional Office for Western Pacific with regional institutions
geographic_scope: WHO Western Pacific Member States and journals
notes: Active 2026 journal selection criteria listed; index coverage must not be equated to study origin.

name: Latin American and Caribbean Health Sciences Literature
operator: BIREME PAHO WHO and regional cooperating centers
languages: Spanish;Portuguese;other regional languages not exhaustively confirmed
notes: Official PAHO document confirms LILACS complements MEDLINE; portal path to recheck for live access.

name: African Journals Online
geographic_scope: Africa-published peer-reviewed journal hosting and metadata
notes: AJOL is a host/index service not the publisher; member journals own their peer review.

name: Directory of Open Access Journals
notes: Peer review and editorial criteria; a DOAJ listing does not appraise specific research.

name: Scientific Electronic Library Online (SciELO)
geographic_scope: National collections in Latin America and additional countries incl Spain Portugal South Africa
notes: 2023 formal program describes 16 national collections; 2026 membership should be rechecked at live collection list.

name: J-STAGE
geographic_scope: Japan scholarly society and research-organization publications
notes: Platform includes journals proceedings magazines; individual item publication type must be classified.

name: Thai Journals Online (ThaiJO)
geographic_scope: Thailand-produced academic journals; hosting not the same as TCI ranking
notes: Official ThaiJO operator confirms OJS hosting and cooperation with KMUTT and NECTEC; inclusion is not TCI ranking or medical validation.

name: DergiPark
geographic_scope: Academic journals published in Türkiye; hosting, not a clinical index
notes: The provider explicitly says it does not manage or judge hosted scientific content; do not confuse hosting with TR Dizin.

name: Magiran
operator: Magiran journal bibliographic/periodical aggregation service; legal operator details pending
notes: Persian periodical record and exact article metadata visible; publisher peer review and index selection rules require independent check.
